author: More Perfect Union
description:
Airports are ripping you off even more than you realized.

Food and drink is often only supposed to cost 15% more at airports than it does outside.

But when we went to investigate we found prices 50%-90% higher, and multi-billion dollar corporations making huge profits.

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Meta’s Muse bot is supposed to look cute, but in reality it’s creepy and even dangerous.

Muse AI gave out one user’s address without asking him, read another person’s texts without permission, and even spies on users’ friends.

It’s compiling dossiers on everyone who uses it, and even people who don’t.
title: Zuck’s new little spy is always watching… even if you’re not using it
